sys_script_include.description: Builds the outbound VAMP payload (envelope plus one finding element) for an application vulnerable item. Sections and their fields come from the properties usem.vamp.avit.sections and usem.vamp.avit.fields.<section>.
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor

sys_script_include.description: Sends a VAMP payload to the Kafka topic held in usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id with sn_ih_kafka.ProducerV2 (key <table>.<sys_id>). Documentation of API used - https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/api-reference/server-api-reference/ProducerV2ScopedAPI.html
sys_script_include.name: BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp

sys_properties.description: sys_id of the Kafka Topic record [sys_kafka_topic] for sn_usem_verification_outbound, read by BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp.
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.kafka.topic_sys_id

sys_properties.description: VAMP payload fields, one servicenow_field=payload_field pair per line in payload order: the ServiceNow field on the left (verified with the field check script), the payload name of the sheet "SN to VAMP" on the right; the fields of the application vulnerable item first, then the fields of the related tables as <table>.<field> (sn_vul_app_vul_entry, sn_vul_app_vulnerability, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request). A field missing on the table or empty is sent as "".
sys_properties.name: x_boar_bofa_usem_1.usem.vamp.fields.sn_vul_app_vulnerable_item
sys_properties.value: number=number, sys_created_on=sys_created_on, sys_updated_on=sys_updated_on, state=state, cmdb_ci=configuration_item, u_verification_status=u_verification_status, source_avit_id=source_avit_id, sn_vul_app_vul_entry.number=number, sn_vul_app_vulnerability.number=number, sn_vul_app_vulnerability.primary_ait=primary_ait, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.number=number, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.sys_created_on=sys_created_on, sn_vul_pen_test_assessment_request.u_assessment_id=u_assessment_id,

sys_script.description: Builds the VAMP payload for the application vulnerable item with BOFASIVampOutboundProcessor and sends it with BOFASIKafkaProducerVamp on every insert and update.
sys_script.name: BOFA_BR_AVIT_VampOutbound
